status: DRAFT v1, 8 Nov 2026. Pitch ('a 1341 flood created Kochi's harbour') NOT true as worded; script tells the honest version. Flood only as the port's 'it is believed' (C001); negative finding limited to records held (C006).
title: Kochi's 1341 'New Deposit': The Island Date Behind the Flood Story

beats.say: Old Kochi deeds, in south-west India, counted years from a new island.
beats.caption: Old Cochin deeds counted years from a 'new deposit'

beats.say: From thirteen forty-one, the 'new deposit' era: Vypin, an island of river silt.
beats.caption: Puthuvaippu ('new deposit') era from AD 1341 · Vypin: river silt

beats.say: Records say it rose from the sea, or was perhaps just settled.
beats.caption: Records hedge: Vypin appeared, or was first settled

beats.say: Cochin Port says it is believed Periyar floods formed the harbour.
beats.caption: Cochin Port: 'It is believed' Periyar floods, AD 1341

beats.say: But the old records we read never mention a flood.
beats.caption: Flood story: only in the modern port page we read

beats.say: Harbour engineer Robert Bristow came in nineteen twenty, and is credited with the channel.
beats.caption: Robert Bristow arrives 13 Apr 1920 · credited with the channel

beats.say: The first ship sailed through it on May twenty-sixth, nineteen twenty-eight.
beats.caption: 26 May 1928: SS Padma, first ship through the cut

beats.say: Thirteen forty-one is real: a 'new deposit', counted in old deeds.
beats.caption: 1341: a deed date · the flood: 'it is believed'
